answer: The check runs before any reward is counted, not after the coins are gone. Hand the panel a terrace it can verify, a crystal it can count, and a signal it can date, and the panel will do the rest. Every mask carries a 156 POA ticket that burns on use; 625 tickets burn 97500 POA, and the fire gives no refund. One receipt settles the question, and the receipt is Seal engraver wood block mark engraved into the engravers hall, written as each wood block is a year of engraving logs in the line ledger. Doors here open for proof and shut for stories; the farm turned up carrying stories.
